lines.text: Many learners say: I did a mistake.

native.tip: نقول بالعامية «عملت غلطة» فنترجمها did، لكن الصحيح make a mistake: “I made a mistake.” وليس “I did a mistake.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I did a mistake.” 😅 نقول بالعامية «عملت غلطة» فنترجمها did، لكن الصحيح make a mistake، فالجملة الصحيحة “I made a mistake.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.tip: In spoken Arabic we say «عملت غلطة», so we use did, but in English we make a mistake: “I made a mistake.” not “I did a mistake.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I did a mistake.” 😅 In spoken Arabic we say «عملت غلطة», so we use did, but in English we make a mistake, so the right sentence is “I made a mistake.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
